summary: Thin wrapper that forwards its dwMilliseconds argument to the imported Sleep function. No state of its own; exists to decouple the polling loop from the sleep API.

operations.description: Invoke Sleep(dwMilliseconds), forwarding the caller-supplied millisecond count to the imported Sleep function at 0x0059E0DC.
Function is void; control returns to the caller immediately after the Sleep call returns.

unresolved: The __thiscall convention implies an unused this pointer; no member field is touched, so the object role is unknown.
